units.source_text: 我不知道海面什么时候昏沉下来。

en.t: I did not know when the surface of the sea had grown dark and heavy.

units.source_text: 网代和热海已经闪耀着灯光。

en.t: Ajiro and Atami were already glittering with lights.

units.source_text: 我的肌肤感到一股凉意，肚子也有点饿了。

en.t: I felt a chill on my skin, and I was beginning to feel a little hungry too.

units.source_text: 少年给我打开竹叶包的食物。

en.t: The boy opened the food wrapped in bamboo leaves for me.

units.source_text: 我忘了这是人家的东西，把紫菜饭团抓起来就吃。

en.t: Forgetting that it belonged to someone else, I grabbed the rice ball wrapped in seaweed and ate it.

units.source_text: 吃罢，钻进了少年学生的斗篷里，生出一股美好而又空虚的情绪，

en.t: After eating, I slipped into the student boy's cloak, and a feeling that was beautiful yet empty arose in me,

units.source_text: 无论别人多么亲切地对待我，我都非常自然地接受了。

en.t: No matter how kindly others treated me, I accepted it with complete naturalness.

units.source_text: 明早我将带着老婆子到上野站去买前往水户的车票，

en.t: Tomorrow morning I would take the old woman to Ueno Station to buy tickets for Mito,

units.source_text: 这也是完全应该做的事。

en.t: and that too was something entirely proper to do.

units.source_text: 我感到一切的一切都融为一体了。

en.t: I felt that everything, absolutely everything, had melted into one.
